context: Saito gives Sho a routine checkup.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: しょうくん、健康、本当、いい、ね。
lines.en: Sho-kun, you're truly in wonderful health.
lines.style: Warm, steady professional gaze. Opening with genuine pleasure at the news. Soft cadence—not rushing. The composure of someone who has delivered good news many times, but means it each time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I've been working really hard at it.
lines.style: Small, serious voice—six years old finding the words. Quiet pride underneath. A slight lift at the end, checking that he's done something right. Genuine effort audible in the careful delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: You're such a kind child, truly.
lines.style: Soft surprise in the opening. The appreciation is real and reaches her eyes before it reaches her voice. Steady, unhurried delivery. A moment of seeing him—not just as a patient.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It's fun when we do it together.
lines.style: Small, warm voice. The brightness of a six-year-old who has found something that works. Gentle sincerity—no performance. A tiny exhale of contentment woven through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Keep taking good care of yourself, all right?
lines.style: Closing with quiet conviction. A gentle instruction wrapped in care, not command. The voice settles—a promise held between doctor and patient that this partnership continues.
